_source: Indiana Commission for Higher Education / Ivy Tech / My College Core (verified via web search, Aug 2026) + FCHS Dual Credit Crosswalk documents for institution-specific credit hours
overview: A block of 30 college credit hours across 6 competency areas, guaranteed to transfer between all Indiana public colleges and universities. Awarded as a certificate once complete.
global_rules: Minimum 3 credit hours required in EACH of the 6 categories (18 credits minimum across categories); the remaining 12 credits toward the 30-credit total can come from any qualifying category, up to a max of 15 credits counted from any single category.

At least 15 of the 30 total credit hours must come directly through FCHS's primary dual-credit postsecondary partner, Vincennes University - not from AP scores or other institutions' dual credit. This is a hard requirement for the certificate to be awarded, tracked separately in the site as a Vincennes-sourced subtotal.
Dual credit courses generally require a minimum 2.0 GPA in those specific courses for the credit to count toward the certificate (self-reported on this site, not derived from course selection).

AP courses can count toward the Core, but only when the student earns a qualifying exam score (commonly 3 or higher, though this can vary by receiving institution and subject) - self-reported on this site since exam scores aren't available from course selection alone.

This site's category assignments and credit-hour estimates are built from FCHS's own Dual Credit Crosswalk documents where a course has confirmed Vincennes/Ivy Tech data, and from general standard college credit-hour equivalents where a course is AP-only with no FCHS-confirmed dual-credit pairing. AP-only estimates are marked separately in the data and should be treated as approximate - actual credit and category placement depends on the receiving institution's own AP credit policy.
